title: Movers & Shakers Storytime
description: Movers & Shakers Storytime Movers & Shakers Storytime @ Lumpkin Lumpkin County Library Branch Wednesdays from 11:00 - 11:45 am Come move, shake, sing, and learn! This program is designed for preschoolers ages 3, 4, and 5 , along with their parent(s) or caregiver(s). We’ll enjoy stories, songs, fingerplays, movement, and fun activities that encourage early literacy, creativity, and a love of learning. Siblings are always welcome! title: Book Babies Storytime
description: Book Babies Storytime Book Babies Storytime @ Lumpkin Lumpkin County Library Branch It’s never too early to chew on a good book! This program is designed for babies (along with parent(s)) from birth to 18 months . We’ll be creating building blocks of early literacy through songs, action rhymes, books, and playtime. These are wonderful times for your babies to hear lots of language, and a great opportunity for you to meet new parents! (Structured activity for 15 minutes with playtime after). title: Yoga to Thrive
description: Yoga to Thrive Yoga to Thrive Yoga to Thrive is a yoga class for all age groups and for all experience levels. It will consist of low impact yoga postures that gradually warm up muscles, joints and connective tissues. The class will be led by registered yoga teacher, Martha Dickerson, owner and instructor of Yahoola Yoga Studio. No registration is required for this FREE class.
